title: Each failing required job in a batch run wakes the batch runner as it fails
why: Owner chat 12:14 CST Nov 12, page item 559 pick c: "ah ok C is good go for it".
note: Each required job that fails posts the red-run notice as it fails, so the batch runner starts the drop and fix at once; the other jobs run on and name any second bad lane; the new head's run replaces the old one. R4's lint-first cancel stays beside it. Home: decision ci-wait-reads-run-status (the red-run comment rule). Why not cancel: red builds carry about 2 bad lanes each (147 drops over 74 builds, Nov 11 audit). Red first. Plan R53 (owner 13:07 CST Nov 12, restart-plan 4c91998): "i think any ci / merge relaterd thing should be just an alert for batch runner to either then address or bring to coordinator right". A CI or merge alarm (red main, a job at its time cap, a dropped check run) wakes the batch runner and opens no GitHub issue. This step is the one home for the main-run wake (coordinator 13:08 CST); PR #2745's cap alarm calls it. Triage sent R53 and the cap alarm lane's three questions to this lane 13:10 CST.
